title: High-score Worker operations
description: The routes the Hivestorm Worker answers; everything else under its route is a static asset.

entities.name: Open the game
entities.description: The game's page, for players who are signed in.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole).
entities.result: The page from the static assets, marked Cache-Control: private, no-cache.
failures: Signed out, or the login service out of reach: a redirect to /auth/sign-in that returns to the same address, ?match=ID included.

entities.name: Issue a game's seed
entities.description: Starts a game that may later enter the table.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: { id, seed }: a new random id and 32-bit seed, stored as unused. Unused seeds older than 24 hours are deleted on the way.
failures: Not signed in, or without the role: 401 from the sign-in library.

entities.name: Submit a game
entities.description: Puts a finished game's players on the table, after replaying it.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: The seed is marked used, and each player who gave a name and scored more than 0 is stored with the replay's score and wave; returns { entries: [{ player, name, score, wave, rank }] }.
failures: Not JSON, an id that is not a string of up to 64 characters, or names not a list of one or two: 400.
A name with nothing left once cleaned, or every name null: 400.
A seed that is unknown, used or older than 24 hours, or claimed by another submission first: 409.
Runs that do not replay one whole game, or a game with a different number of players than names: 422; the seed stays usable.
Not signed in, or without the role: 401 from the sign-in library.

entities.name: Read the table
entities.description: The best ten scores, as JSON for the game's own table screen.
entities.result: { scores: [{ name, score, wave, players }] }, best first, ties oldest first.

entities.name: Show the scores page
entities.description: The best 25 scores as a web page in icelander.net's look.
entities.result: An HTML page with names escaped; /games/retro/hivestorm/scores redirects to it with 301.

relatedViews.relationship: The use cases that call them.
